record.title: Photograph of Roy Crane

ancestors.title: Records of the Bureau of Prisons

creators.heading: Department of Justice. Bureau of Prisons. U.S. Penitentiary, Leavenworth. 1930-

record.scopeAndContentNote: This item is the prison photograph, also known as the "mug shot," of Leavenworth inmate Roy Crane, register number 12028. The photograph is divided into two parts. One side captures the inmate's right profile from the middle of the arm to the top of the head. The other side shows a frontal view from the middle of the chest to the top of the head.
